contributionMap.claim: The half-lazy random walk on K_{m,n} has entropy contraction coefficient log M/(2 log 2M), M = max(m, n), with only point extremisers for M >= 3; rank-one weights; lazy star (Theorem 6.1, Corollary 6.2). This proves the conjecture of Caputo, Chen, Gu and Polyanskiy.

limitationTriage.limitation: Priority holds only within a bounded literature search.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Has a general-prior reverse-erasure formula or an all-n proof of the conjecture been stated elsewhere?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Dated searches of 1 and 3 November 2026; one citation index rate-limited; no subscription-database search; no author enquiry.
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: Exhaustive search and author enquiry are outside this release; disclosed in the paper and README.
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: Requires specialist databases and contact with the conjecture authors.

limitationTriage.limitation: Above the threshold there is no closed form; uniqueness of the tangency solution and the asymptotics of eta - c_0 are open.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Is the tangency solution unique, at least for binary priors?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Attainment, full support and exponential-tilt structure proved (Theorem 2.7); near-threshold excess tabulated numerically (Remark 5.2).
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: Beyond the scope of this release.

limitationTriage.limitation: For laziness other than 1/2, for powers and for multipartite graphs only the reduction is proved; the values and the point-optimality windows are numerical.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Is there a closed description of the laziness phase diagram?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Reduction to at most two states per block proved (Section 7); laziness grid, powers and multipartite cases computed with five must-fail controls.
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: An analytic phase diagram is a separate project.

limitationTriage.limitation: The result is a one-step, rank-one statement; it gives no mixing-time improvement (the spectral gap is 1/2) and does not extend to arbitrary cross weights.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Do bounds in terms of the distance from rank one exist?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Counterexample to extension beyond rank one recorded in Section 9.
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: Beyond the scope of this release.

limitationTriage.limitation: Scripts used assert gates and overwrote their recorded output (review objection).
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Do the checks still fail under -O without touching recorded outputs?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Explicit failure collection and exit status; --output-dir required and overwrite refused; normal and -O outputs recorded; clean replay at release.

limitationTriage.limitation: Random tests had little power near sharp boundaries (review objection).
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Do the checks detect false versions of the main claims?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Ten must-fail negative controls (all detected) plus near-extremiser families; five further controls for Section 7.
